description: This Java source file defines the `ConceptAnswersEditor` class, a custom property editor used within the OpenMRS framework for handling lists of concept answer identifiers and associated drugs. It provides methods for parsing string input, updating collections of ConceptAnswer objects, and maintaining answer order and sorting.

classes.name: ConceptAnswersEditor
classes.description: A Java Bean PropertyEditor supporting editing of concept-answer lists associated with a question, including parsing user input, updating, and ordering per user specifications.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Parses a string of concept and drug IDs, updates the collection of ConceptAnswer objects accordingly, and maintains order and sort weights.

methods.name: getConceptAnswerFromOriginal
methods.description: Finds and returns the ConceptAnswer with a specific concept ID from the original collection.

methods.name: getConceptId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the concept ID from a string formatted as 'conceptId' or 'conceptId^drugId'.

methods.name: getDrugId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the drug ID from a string formatted as 'conceptId^drugId', or null if not present.
